**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Authenticate historical receipts against frozen bytes**

When the issue #1749 validator runs against a successor such as the checked-in #1752 release, these expected receipts are calculated from the files being validated rather than from frozen #1749 authority. Because this validator also does not pin the successor manifest's raw hash, a modified Quadratics delta and historical snapshot can be accepted after updating their receipts in the active manifest; I reproduced this and `validate_checked_release()` returned successfully. Retain the previous deterministic rebuild comparison or pin both the successor manifest and historical artifact receipts independently.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Permit rebuilding when the active manifest is missing**

When the issue #1751 materializer runs without `--check` in a repository that retains its authenticated issue #1750 predecessor snapshot but has no active manifest—for example during clean regeneration or rollback—this unconditional read raises `FileNotFoundError` before reaching the existing `build_release()` and write branch. Before this change, that invocation regenerated the release; guard the read with `is_file()` as the issue #1750 materializer does so an absent active manifest remains rebuildable.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include base-graph classifications in canonical records**

The canonical-record builder indexes only P1 overlay edges even though the served semantic authority combines the authenticated P3 base graph with that overlay. As a result, inherited P1 classifications already present in `kg-v0-edges.json` disappear from the newly published canonical records: for example, `qrow_9709_m16_qp_12_q02::q02` has an approved base `PART_CLASSIFIED_AS` edge to `9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain` and the API returns that type, but its canonical record contains an empty `approved_question_type_refs`; 17 approved parts have this mismatch. Merge the authenticated base classification edges into this index before hashing and publishing the records.
